description: Track satellites and the radio passes recorded by SatNOGS, the Libre Space Foundation's open network of volunteer ground stations. Search SatNOGS DB for satellites and their transmitters by name, mode or frequency, and get a satellite's latest orbital elements (TLE); list and read observations with their rating and links to the waterfall, audio and decoded data, the passes scheduled next, and the ground stations near a place. A trigger starts a workflow when a satellite's pass is recorded. No account or API key required.

satnogs_new_observation_trigger.description: Runs when a SatNOGS ground station's recorded pass of a satellite is rated good, bad or failed (or, for any, as soon as it ends), with links to its waterfall, audio and decoded data. SatNOGS is checked every 10 minutes

parameters.description: The satellite to watch, such as the ISS. Leave empty to watch every satellite the ground station records.
parameters.name: satellite

parameters.description: Only passes this ground station records. Leave empty for every station; choose a satellite, a station, or both.
parameters.name: ground_station

parameters.description: Which passes start the workflow: good (the default: a signal was received), bad, failed, or any (every pass, as soon as it ends).
parameters.name: status
